test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 5 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In Union Budget 2021-22, PLI schemes for 13 key sectors of manufacturing starting from fiscal year (FY) 2021-22 have been announced. The full form of PLI is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Production Linked Incentive.**____** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Production Linked Incentive Scheme** (PLI) for Large Scale Electronics Manufacturing.
 
• The government has allotted an outlay of** ₹1.97 lakh crore** in the preceding Union Budget **(2021-22) for PLI schemes.**
 
• **Automobiles & Auto Components: Department of Heavy Industry. Advance Chemistry Cell (ACC) Battery: Department of Heavy Industry. Textile Products: MMF segment and technical textiles: Ministry of Textiles. Specialty Steel: Ministry of Steel** is the 14 sectors of the PLI scheme.
 
• PLI scheme helps the **anchor investors proficient **in managing the Greenfield or brownfield projects and other investments. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The outlay in** 2021-22 **has increased at an early rate of **14% over 2019-20.**
 
• The** Union Minister for Finance & Corporate Affairs, Smt Nirmala Sitharaman** introduced the Union Budget 2021-22 in Parliament.
 
• It is the **earliest budget of this new decade **and as well a digital one against the backdrop of the unparalleled** COVID-19 crisis.**
